title: Make the next attempt use the last result
task: Repair persisted document word counts. Implement the loop stop rule and the feedback message sent to the next fresh Pi session. Run one bounded round, inspect the checks and checkpoint, then explicitly continue only if your rule allows it. Each round keeps the previous candidate; limits remain enforced by the supplied runner.
hints: Test success, failure, round limit and deadline separately. A deadline is an absolute timestamp saved once, not a new allowance on resume.
Use the observed failed checks in nextPrompt. The previous candidate source is staged separately; the prior conversation is not.
Run one round at a time. The checkpoint shows the original deadline, source hashes and feedback hash. A stopped loop needs an explicit new execution; recovery never replaces a missing trial.

title: Make control flow inspectable
task: Write the graph routing policy and a narrow repair plan. Verify the unfinished candidate, route its observed failure to repair, and inspect the next candidate. Choose serial or parallel independent service and Electron checks. A verified candidate pauses for your explicit checksum-bound decision. Failed candidates remain available; a failed repair rolls back to the starting snapshot.
